# Task: #7213 slice 8 — burn down the subprocess-timeout allowlist for `scripts/lexicon/` (incl. `runner/`) (one PR)

Follow the merged pattern of slices 1–7 (#7214/#7215/#7217/#7231/#7239/#7243/#7245): a named module-level constant
per bound class, `TimeoutExpired` mapped onto each site's EXISTING failure semantics, one test per touched site
exercising the real code path with a monkeypatched `TimeoutExpired`.

This slice covers ONLY the 21 allowlist entries under `scripts/lexicon/` (9) and `scripts/lexicon/runner/` (12).

## Outcome
Every `scripts/lexicon/` entry is either fixed (bounded, removed from the allowlist) or explicitly skipped with a
one-line reason in the PR body. No other directories.

## Rules for values
- Grep each module for existing `timeout=` / budget conventions FIRST and reuse them. The lexicon runner supervises
  model/verification children — derive bounds from the runner's own budgets; a child the module itself designs as
  unbounded (e.g. passes `--no-timeout`, or has its own watchdog) is a SKIP with reason, never an invented number
  (slice-7 lesson: three invented 300 s caps had to be reverted).
- Local git / file tools: tens of seconds. Network/API/model helpers: minutes, from the module's own budget.
- Map `TimeoutExpired` onto each site's existing failure shape; per-item loops fail the ITEM, never the pass, and
  never swallow a failure the pass previously aborted on.

## STANDING ACCEPTANCE ITEMS (from slices 6–7 — both mandatory)
A. **Clobber self-audit:** restructuring a `subprocess.run` call into try/except has twice deleted an ADJACENT
   statement (a `return`; a ledger write). After editing, diff every touched function against main and put this
   exact line in the PR body: `clobber self-audit: N hunks reviewed, 0 deletions beyond the intended sites` — and
   make it true.
B. **Entry-point smoke:** for every touched module, `python -c "import <module>"` (and `--help`/dry-run where a CLI
   exists); quote each command + result.
C. **Referencing-suite sweep:** `grep -rl "<module>" tests/` for EVERY touched module and run ALL of those files —
   not a hand-picked subset (slice 7 missed a hash-pinning compatibility suite that way and got kicked from the
   merge queue). If any touched module's bytes are pinned by a hash/receipt/matrix, re-pin through that artifact's
   own documented procedure in the same commit.

## Acceptance (quote raw output; PRIMARY interpreter; from YOUR worktree root; `git sparse-checkout add curriculum
wiki` first if fixtures need it)
1. `/Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_subprocess_timeout_guard.py` green
   (allowlist shrank; no stale entries; any test you add bounds its own subprocess calls).
2. Items A, B, C above, all quoted.
3. Ruff clean.
4. Table in the PR body: entry → fixed (constant + value + derivation) / skipped (why). Counts: fixed N, skipped M;
   remaining `scripts/lexicon/` entries must be exactly M.
5. One conventional commit (`fix(lexicon): bound subprocess calls — allowlist burn-down slice 8 (#7213)`,
   X-Agent trailer). NO push, NO auto-merge, NO amend after reporting. Report HEAD SHA + evidence + ready PR body
   (RETURN text; the driver posts).
